The Minister of Marine and Blue Economy, Dr. Adegboyega Oyetola, has congratulated the former Managing Director of the National Inland Waterways Authority (NIWA) and former All Progressives Congress (APC) governorship candidate in Osun State, Munirudeen Bola Oyebamiji, on his 61st birthday. In a congratulatory message issued on Wednesday by his Special Adviser, Dr. Bolaji Akinola, Oyetola described the celebrant as an accomplished banker, astute administrator, dependable political associate and committed public servant whose contributions to governance and institutional development remain commendable. The minister acknowledged Oyebamiji’s record of service across various institutions and public offices, particularly his tenure as Managing Director of NIWA, his contributions to the Federal Ministry of Marine and Blue Economy and his service as Osun State Commissioner for Finance. He noted that Oyebamiji had consistently demonstrated professionalism, administrative competence, political loyalty and commitment to the public good. According to Oyetola, Oyebamiji’s journey through the banking sector, public service and politics reflects his dedication to excellence and societal development. His remarkable journey in the banking sector, public service and politics reflects a deep commitment to excellence and the development of our society,” he said. AMBO, as he is fondly known, has demonstrated uncommon dedication to every responsibility entrusted to him. His professionalism, humility and steadfast commitment to service are qualities worthy of emulation,” the Minister stated. He also commended Oyebamiji’s resilience and continued engagement in the political arena, describing it as a reflection of his passion for the progress of Osun State and Nigeria. The minister expressed confidence that the experience and wisdom Oyebamiji had acquired over the years would continue to benefit the APC, Osun State and the country. Oyetola wished him many more years of good health, peace and greater accomplishments.
